purpose: First-pass coverage only. Previously investigated CPOs are deferred until all known CPOs have received at least one pass.

findings: Official price sheet valid from 2026-02-01 gives the contracted Flensburger Ladekarte tariff: AC 0.39 EUR/kWh, DC 0.49 EUR/kWh, blocking 0.10 EUR/min after 240 min capped at 12 EUR. This is not promoted as the ad-hoc/direct price.
Public m8mit station pages confirm DE*SFL EVSEs and Stadtwerke Flensburg GmbH as operator, including AC and DC examples.

A current station-level third-party page reports direct card payment at one AC site at 0.59 EUR/kWh plus 1.50 EUR start fee. Because this conflicts with the contracted card tariff and is not an official network-wide direct tariff, no prefix-wide direct offer is created.
newFirstPass.nextAfterTraversal: Enumerate DE*SFL direct-payment checkout values and confirm whether the 0.59 EUR/kWh + 1.50 EUR structure is universal or station-specific.

findings: Official 2026 electromobility page states that charging can be started with the SWE card or QR code and that users without a card can pay by credit card or PayPal.
Official contracted SWE card product currently lists AC 0.54 EUR/kWh and DC 0.64 EUR/kWh, with lower prices for SWE energy customers. These card prices are not assumed to equal QR/direct payment.

Public station data confirms DE*EMD EVSEs, for example DE*EMD*E001301 and DE*EMD*E001302. No trustworthy current numeric ad-hoc price was exposed in the sources checked, so direct pricing remains fail-closed.
newFirstPass.nextAfterTraversal: Probe the public QR/direct checkout for representative DE*EMD EVSEs and map exact direct prices by station if exposed.

findings: Official current page identifies AVG as the charging-infrastructure operator/partner with ladenetz.de and lists 68 current public charging points across 23 sites.

From 2026-06-01 AVG explicitly offers a separate ad-hoc tariff via QR code/app/debit or credit card and separate AC/DC pricing, with occupancy fees after 240 min AC and 90 min DC; the page's numeric tariff table is image-only in the accessible text, so no numeric value is inferred.

Station data confirms the DE*AVG namespace, for example DE*AVG*E003010 at Parkhaus Suedbahnhof. Since the official numeric ad-hoc values could not be extracted reliably in this pass, pricing remains fail-closed.
newFirstPass.nextAfterTraversal: Recover the official image-only tariff matrix or query the ladenetz direct checkout for DE*AVG EVSEs; do not infer values from the stated 0.06 EUR/kWh reduction.

coherence.notes: Initial Kiel and Pfalzwerke candidates were discarded before investigation because PR #69 already contains dedicated direct-offer files for both.
